$comment: Per-function `deno check` error ceilings for supabase/functions/**, enforced by
scripts/deno-check-functions.mjs and the `edge-typecheck` CI job.
These numbers are DEBT, not a target. The edge tree went untypechecked for the
life of the project — no `deno check` anywhere, no covering tsconfig, no nx
target — so the first run over it surfaced 83 pre-existing errors. Blocking on
zero would have forced an unrelated auth/handler cleanup into whatever PR added
the gate; the ratchet instead writes the debt down and fails the moment a number
goes UP.
A CEILING may only be LOWERED. If a run comes in under one of these, the job
prints the lower numbers and asks you to commit them, which is how the debt
shrinks. Raising one is never the right fix for a failing check: the change that
added the error is.
`health` and `openapi` are already at 0 and must stay there.
What the remaining errors are, so the next person does not have to re-derive it:
- optional-handling gaps (`params.min_score`, `body.limit` possibly undefined)
in memories/handlers/{relevant,search}.ts — these look like latent bugs
- `never`-typed rows in _shared/api/auth.ts, which may mean the generated DB
types are stale (`pnpm nx db:types supabase`)
- `.single()`-vs-array casts repeated across the org handlers (`{id}[]` cast to
`{id}`), 5+ occurrences of one copied line
- postgrest version skew: `referencedTable` missing from the installed
`.order()` option type
- a fire-and-forget `.catch()` on a `PromiseLike<void>` in _shared/usage.ts
